title: KAIA set to perform at Music Matters Live festival in Singapore
summary: P-pop girl group KAIA is set to lead the “Made in the Philippines” spotlight at Music Matters Live in Singapore on Saturday, Oct. 3. The five-member group will take the Music Matters Live Mainstage…

blocks.text: P-pop girl group KAIA is set to lead the “Made in the Philippines” spotlight at Music Matters Live in Singapore on Saturday, Oct. 3. The five-member group will take the Music Matters Live Mainstage at Clarke Quay along with fellow Filipino girl group PIX!E, under the Philippine spotlight presented by the National Commission for Culture and the Arts. Aside from the P-pop groups, Filipino rock band Lola Amour is also set to perform at the music festival on Sunday, Oct. 4.
